title: TF Lite Task Library: Plug‑and‑Play AI 📦
description: Use pre‑built components for image classification, object detection, and text recognition in minutes.

slides.title: No More Manual Tensor Wrangling 🎁
slides.content:
# What is the Task Library?

A set of high‑level, ready‑to‑use libraries built on top of TFLite:
- **ImageClassifier**, **ObjectDetector**, **ImageSegmenter**, **ImageEmbedder**
- **NLClassifier**, **BertNLClassifier**, **BertQuestionAnswerer**
- **AudioClassifier**

They handle model loading, preprocessing, inference, and postprocessing automatically.

> Analogy: Ordering a pizza instead of cooking from scratch – you still enjoy the result.

slides.title: Android: Image Classification in 5 Lines

quizData.question: Which of these tasks is NOT directly supported by the TF Lite Task Library?
quizData.explanation: The Task Library covers common vision and NLP tasks, but not arbitrary custom models like style transfer directly.

slides.title: Object Detection Example 📸
slides.content:
# Using ObjectDetector

Load a model like EfficientDet‑Lite, and get bounding boxes and labels.

```kotlin
val detector = ObjectDetector.createFromFile(context, modelPath)
val image = TensorImage.fromBitmap(bitmap)
val detections = detector.detect(image)
for (d in detections) {
    val rect = d.boundingBox
    // Draw rect on canvas
}
```

All preprocessing (resizing, normalisation) is handled internally.

slides.title: iOS: Task Library (Swift)
slides.content: Similar convenience on iOS via `TensorFlowLiteTaskVision` pod.

slides.title: Custom Models with Task Library 🛠️
slides.content: You can use custom TFLite models with Task Library by providing metadata (label file, normalization params). Use the TFLite Model Maker to add metadata easily.
